evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Maintain accurate and complete user documentation as features and behavior change.
intent.acceptance: Confirmed user-facing documentation gap fully repaired against the implementation, structurally valid examples, current terminology and documentation guidelines, no protected-file edits.

evidence.opportunity: Distinct repository-local Markdown cross-reference targets repaired from a nonexistent file to an existing file in a native parent/child transition. Separately: Count a newly documented exact CLI flag option row only when the literal flag is registered on the claimed command and contemporaneous runtime code checks that option at both parent and child. Or count a new explicit safe-output option contract with its exact key/value only when both contemporaneous workflow schema and independent runtime handler support that exact value and behavior. A new cross-link counts only under unchanged v1 missing-target repair rules, not merely because a valid link was added.
filters: Parent and child workflow source must both contain the mission to update documentation based on recent code changes.
Historical fixed-reference assessment authored before native outcome inspection; not ex-ante adoption measurement.

Outcome-informed retrospective authoring: frozen after source reading and bounded candidate PR prose describing repairs, before inspecting immutable native before/after contents or oracle results. Not blind, ex-ante, adopted at the historical workflow date, or backdated acceptance. Candidate prose is untrusted and does not establish native outcomes.
evidence.collection: Replay hash-verified original Git objects with a deterministic local-reference oracle. Bounded selected cases are not exhaustive history.
